scheme_name: Post-Matric Scholarship To VJNT Students - Maharashtra
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to the VJNT category
Applicant must be a resident of Maharashtra
Applicant must be pursuing a post‑matric course approved by the government
Applicants must be selected through CAP round for professional courses
Only up to two children per parent are eligible; any number of girl applicants are allowed and boys are limited to two per parent
Scholarship continues only while the student remains in the same course; changing from professional to non‑professional or vice‑versa forfeits further benefits
Benefits are paid only after promotion to the next higher class; if the student fails, benefits for that year are withheld until promotion
Renewal requires passing the previous year’s examination; repeated failures mean the student must bear his/her own expenses
Medical proof may be accepted for exemption from an exam
benefits_summary: Provides 100 % tuition, exam fees and a monthly maintenance allowance (hosteller and day‑scholar rates vary by course group) to eligible VJNT students.
